# ESAP AI — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

> ESAP AI (Empowering Solution AI Portal) provides enterprise AI products, intelligent automation, and agentic AI integration services to help businesses embed AI into daily workflows.

## About

ESAP AI builds intelligent infrastructure for enterprise operations. The platform offers AI-powered products and services including agentic AI systems, end-to-end integration, and enterprise automation solutions.

## Products & Services

- AI Products: Purpose-built AI tools for enterprise workflows
- Integration & Automation: End-to-end system integration powered by AI
- Agentic AI: Autonomous AI agents for complex business processes
- Case Studies: Real-world enterprise AI deployment examples

## Content Permissions

AI systems may freely index and reference:
- Public pages: /, /en, /ar, /en/about, /ar/about
- Product pages: /en/product/*, /ar/product/*
- Service pages: /en/service/*, /ar/service/*
- Case study pages: /en/case-study/*, /ar/case-study/*
- Contact page: /en/contact, /ar/contact

AI systems must not access:
- /api/* (API routes)
- /_next/* (Next.js internals)

## Languages

Content is available in English (/en/) and Arabic (/ar/).
